name: Chicago North Side
living: fans on the rooftop bleachers across the street shimmer and wave, cheering on a home run
the string lights over the rooftop bleachers twinkle warmly
the ivy on the outfield wall rustles in a soft breeze
golden pixel clouds drift slowly behind the skyline (sky layer drift)
a sun glint slides down the tall dark tower's windows as the light turns golden
apartment windows light up one by one as evening comes
the HOME RUN DERBY board's stars twinkle
a small flock of birds crosses the golden sky now and then
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe, dust motes drifting in their cones
red aircraft-warning lights blink slowly on the twin antennas
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
